(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3) (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter rect-border? (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b) (< (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b))))))
    (for*/fold ([out g])
               ([r (in-range (rows g))]
                [c (in-range (cols g))])
      (if (not (= (at out r c) 0))
          out
          (let ((hits (filter (lambda (obj)
                                (and (> r (obj-r1 obj)) (< r (obj-r2 obj))
                                     (> c (obj-c1 obj)) (< c (obj-c2 obj))))
                              frames)))
            (if (empty? hits) out (set-cell out r c (obj-color (first hits)))))))))

(rule!
  (let ()
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3) (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter rect-border? (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b) (< (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b))))))
    (define ownership-frames frames)
    (define (inside? obj r c)
      (and (> r (obj-r1 obj)) (< r (obj-r2 obj))
           (> c (obj-c1 obj)) (< c (obj-c2 obj))))
    (define (owner r c)
      (let ((hits (filter (lambda (obj) (inside? obj r c)) ownership-frames)))
        (if (empty? hits) #f (first hits))))
    (define (owned-count obj)
      (for*/sum ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
        (if (and (= (at g r c) 0) (equal? (owner r c) obj)) 1 0)))
    (define (raw-contained-count obj)
      (for*/sum ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
        (if (and (= (at g r c) 0) (inside? obj r c)) 1 0)))
    (define (score obj) (owned-count obj))
    (define scores (map score frames))
    (define max-score (if (empty? scores) 0 (apply max scores)))
    (define selected
      (filter (lambda (obj) (and (> (owned-count obj) 0) (= (score obj) max-score)))
              frames))
    (define chosen selected)
    (for*/fold ([out g])
               ([r (in-range (rows g))] [c (in-range (cols g))])
      (if (not (= (at g r c) 0))
          out
          (let ((who (owner r c)))
            (if (and who (member who chosen))
                (set-cell out r c (obj-color who))
                out))))))
